review.scopeLimit: Independent review covers exhaustive directory pagination, public/authenticated Realtime lifecycle, publication safety, fixture/session custody and the redacted external limitation receipt.

notes: Android, Web/Wasm and iOS exhaust directory profiles and active wall statistics with stable id keysets instead of one transport-limited page. The shared refresh policy emits immediately, reacts to Realtime invalidations and polls after 30 seconds as bounded recovery.

Anonymous sockets subscribe only to the four key-only directory publications. community_messages remains authenticated-only because its legacy publication includes body and created_at; anonymous message-driven wall activity converges through the bounded fallback.

A full encrypted logical backup and affected-table restore drill preceded the release. Migration 20261003183000 committed four key-only publications and the direct SQL audit passed again after reconnect.

The evidence trigger creates only its own UUID wall fixture, journals custody before insertion, recovers a prior journal before a new attempt, removes by exact id/slug/name and leaves zero owned rows or journal residue.

The public Realtime preflight still returns HTTP 402 exceed_egress_quota before WebSocket join, authentication, fixture creation or database mutation. The redacted receipt preserves that sole external runtime limitation without attributing an unattempted authenticated result.

The first independent review returned NO-GO for fixture/session custody, phase attribution and public message payload scope. Product SHA 87263d44 includes all corrections; the final independent review returned GO with no P0-P3 findings.
